Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.card.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EventCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Common base class for every card in the game. Each card carries an immutable identity (id, era, minimum player count) plus two hooks that subclasses override: resolveEffect(GameModel) for the card's own effect and resolveBuildingsEffects(GameModel) for the cascade onto buildings owned by the relevant player(s). Concrete kinds live in the characterCard, eventCard, and buildingCard packages.

    • resolveEffect

      public abstract void resolveEffect(GameModel gameModel)
      Applies the card's effect to the game state. Called by the state machine when the card is resolved (on pick for characters / buildings, at end of round for events).
      Parameters:
      gameModel - current game model

    • addCardToPlayer

      public void addCardToPlayer(Player player) throws InvalidActionException
      Adds this card to the given player's hand. The default implementation always throws, since most cards (notably events) cannot be picked into a hand; subclasses that can be picked override it.
      Parameters:
      player - the player picking the card
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if this card kind is not pickable
